title: TreatmentEpisodes
description: Source-reported treatment episodes. Line numbers are copied only when explicitly documented. v2.1 adds status + status_basis (required; registered from source wording only — organize never infers a line or whether therapy continues beyond what a source says), status_basis_text, status_as_of, line_number and medication_refs; the optional cycle_label_verbatim and status_as_of_precision came later without a version bump (optional fields). A cycle is not a line: every cycle of one regimen is ONE episode. Legacy schema_version "2" archives are read leniently (WARN, not FAIL).

sequence_index.description: Chronological ordering only; not a clinical line number.

documented_line_label.description: Verbatim LINE wording only (二线 / second-line …) when a clinician source states it. Cycle wording (第4程, C2D1 …) is not a line and goes to cycle_label_verbatim.

cycle_label_verbatim.description: Optional verbatim cycle wording of the source the status rests on (第4程, 第二周期, C2D1 …). All cycles of one regimen are ONE episode (started_at = the first cycle's date); the cycle label is recorded here, never as documented_line_label or line_number.

clinician_reported_response.description: Copied from clinician source; never calculated.

status.description: Registered from source wording only (正在/继续/第N程, an imaging request stating the patient is on X, a family statement …).

status_basis.description: Which kind of source the status rests on; reliability is graded downstream.

status_basis_text.description: Verbatim source wording the status rests on.

status_as_of.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the source the status rests on. For status ongoing it is null ONLY in the undated self-report form (status_basis patient_reported + status_as_of_precision undated_self_report).

status_as_of_precision.description: Optional. day (the meaning when absent) = status_as_of is the source's own date. undated_self_report = a patient/family statement that carries no date of its own ("这个方案现在还在用"): status_as_of is null, status_basis is patient_reported and provenance_layer is patient_reported / caregiver_reported (by who said it); downstream words it as an undated family statement to be confirmed with the treating team.

line_number.description: Only when a source literally states the line number; never counted from the episode list.

medication_refs.description: Optional comorbidities.json medications[].medication_id of the order rows this episode was given from.
